name: company-brain
description: An AI operating system for a company, kept in an Obsidian vault: mission, strategy (Value Proposition Canvas, strategy kernel, Playing to Win), OKRs from annual to weekly, opportunity solution trees, effort-impact prioritization, roadmap, org chart, projects, meetings, and weekly notes that pull from your tools. Multiplayer by design: personal, team, and company layers with leak protection.

vault_path.title: Company Brain folder
vault_path.description: The brain vault (the folder that contains brain.yaml). Lets the skills and the brain MCP server work from any directory. Leave empty to use the brain you open Claude in.
